fields.why: The 'rapid death' claim rests on time from exposure to death (20 min to 90 min), the illness's own course, so it is continuous. The five-death total is only the series size, not counts by period or place; the brief should say a case series' own total does not add count/rate.

brief_issues: Brief covers a case total used as a denominator but not a case series' bare total; add: a series total alone does not add count/rate. Only B's record was in the packet; A is rated from its value.
